name: The Shimmering Frond
summary: Across Teldrassil, a curious plant shimmers among the roots and canopy. Travelers bring a cutting to Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth, hoping the botanist can explain its origin.

sections.title: A Strange Glow
sections.body: In Teldrassil's boughs, a strange plant catches the light. Its fronds twist with a pulsing shimmer unlike the island's usual foliage. The glow draws the eye amid Teldrassil's young forest life.

sections.title: Denalan's Discovery
sections.body: At Lake Al'Ameth, Denalan recognizes the cutting as a plant from beyond northern Kalimdor. He last saw one decades ago, during a journey to the Swamp of Sorrows in the Eastern Kingdoms. How its seed crossed the ocean and grew so large on the World Tree puzzles him. Denalan begins cultivating the sample and testing it.

faq.q: Where does the strange plant originally come from?
faq.answer: Denalan says the plant comes from the Swamp of Sorrows in the Eastern Kingdoms. He last saw a living specimen in those marshes decades ago.
Denalan is a night elf botanist and herbalist near Lake Al'Ameth on Teldrassil. He studies and tends the island's growing plant life, experimenting with foreign seeds and planters.

faq.q: Why is this plant growing on Teldrassil?
aliases: how did it get to teldrassil
faq.answer: No one knows how the plant reached Teldrassil. Denalan wonders how a seed crossed the Great Sea from the Eastern Kingdoms, then took root and grew large in Teldrassil's soil.

faq.q: What happens after giving the frond to Denalan?
faq.answer: Denalan places the specimen in his planter at Lake Al'Ameth and begins testing it. Several fronds quickly sprout and blossom, giving him more to study.

faq.q: Does this plant cause corruption in Teldrassil?
faq.answer: No. The plant appears to be an unusual exotic breed in the wrong place, rather than a source of corruption.

angles.text: Herbalists and plant enthusiasts may wonder how a plant from the Swamp of Sorrows thrives so far from its native marshland.
As a druid, you may watch how foreign plant life affects Teldrassil's young canopy.
As a night elf tending your new home, you can see how Denalan's experiments reveal the resilience of Teldrassil's soil.
